rules: do not keep an item merely because it mentions the EU, NATO, a Baltic country or a location

retain Russia/Belarus-linked warnings and information-operation signals
remove culture, sport, lifestyle, weather, general crime and domestic-news noise

treat cyber and critical_infrastructure as conditional rather than automatically strong categories
